title: vectorized-slab-compaction-and-adaptive-nccl-throttle-for-hybrid-tp-runtime
author: Maya Park
release_notes: Improves multi-GPU tensor-parallel throughput and p99 latency by introducing KV cache slab compaction and an NCCL launch-rate throttler tuned for NVLink topologies. No API changes.
commits: Add slab compaction allocator and compact/expand primitives
Implement vectorized coalesced collective path for compacted KV slabs
Introduce NVLink-aware NCCL throttler and topology probe
TP scheduler: prefer coalesced-launch for small-token microbatches
Add perf harness cases and benchmark scripts
Fix race in kvcache eviction path and add unit tests
Polish logging, add feature flags and docs
description:
Motivation: In multi-GPU tensor-parallel serving workloads we observed repeated head-of-line stalls and higher-than-expected allgather volume for KV cache updates when the workload is dominated by many small microbatches (conversation turns, short generations). Small KV entries cause fragmented network payloads and prevent NCCL from issuing efficient vectorized collectives. Additionally, on NVLink-heavy topologies tight back-to-back kernel launches can create transient link congestion that amplifies latency spikes.

Summary: This PR introduces two complementary runtime optimizations: 1) a slab compaction layer for the KV cache that packs small key/value shards into contiguous "slabs" and exposes a vectorized buffer path to the collective layer; 2) an adaptive NCCL launch-rate throttler that probes topology (NVLink/PCIe) and dynamically inserts calibrated micro-delays between collective launches to avoid ring congestion on shared links. Both are gated behind runtime feature flags and conservative defaults.

Design highlights: - Slab compaction: lightweight on-GPU compaction allocator that groups variable-size KV entries into fixed-size slabs. Compaction is applied on eviction and warmup paths; a compacted slab produces a contiguous blob that the vector_coalesce collective will allgather/ allreduce in a single call instead of many small ops. The allocator exposes compact/expand primitives so we can fall back to the legacy path for downloads. Config knobs: TP_SLAB_SIZE (default 64KB), TP_COMPACT_THRESHOLD (default 12 entries). - Vectorized collectives: new vector_coalesce.cc implements gather/scatter helpers that prefer contiguous device buffers; falls back to existing shard path if entries are un-compacted. The implementation minimizes pinned-host staging and reuses persistent NCCL communicators allocated per peer-group. - NCCL throttler: runtime probe collects per-link utilization using NVML + lightweight counters and applies a token-bucket style micro-throttle (NCCL_THROTTLE_US) that spaces collective launches only when probe indicates link saturation. Probe runs during warmup and periodically. Throttle defaults are conservative and only enabled for topologies with shared NVLink links. - Scheduler changes: launch_policy.cc updated to prefer the coalesced-launch path for microbatches < 32 tokens and route large microbatches to the bulk path. Added heuristics to detect mixed-size workload and avoid oscillation.

Testing & Benchmarks: - Unit tests added for slab compactor invariants and expand/compact correctness. - Integration tests exercise mixed small/large token workloads in CI. - Perf harness: ran on 8xA100 NVLink ring and on 4xA40 PCIe nodes. Results (conversation workload, 8xA100 ring): throughput +9% (tokens/sec), p99 latency reduced 12-18% across load points, median latency stable. KV memory utilization decreased ~15% due to reduced fragmentation. On PCIe-only topologies gains are smaller (~3-5%) but p99 still improved due to reduced small-collective overhead. Detailed graphs are in docs/runtime/tp/slab_compaction.md.

Backward compatibility & rollout: - No public API changes; feature is behind two runtime flags (TP_SLAB_COMPACTION, NCCL_THROTTLE). Defaults off for dedicated/private customers; enabled by default in hosted perf lab rollout. - Added guardrails: conservative default throttle values, topology detection, and metrics/alerts (nccl_throttle_restarts, slab_compaction_rate). - Migration: no customer migration required; operators can opt-in or tune via config.

Checklist: - [x] Unit tests for compactor and expand/compact - [x] Integration tests for mixed microbatch paths - [x] Perf benchmarks collected and reviewed - [x] Feature flags and config knobs - [x] Documentation updated - [x] Added metrics and tracing points

Risks and mitigations: - Risk: compaction may increase CPU/GPU overhead during eviction causing small regressions for some workloads. Mitigation: compaction is asynchronous and bounded; can be disabled. - Risk: mis-calibrated throttle may increase latency for bursty traffic. Mitigation: conservative defaults + runtime metrics + quick rollback flag.

Context & related work: follows ENG-2387 (kvcache fragmentation) and ENG-2421 (tp collective failures on mixed microbatches). Builds on prior scheduler improvements and the persistent-communicator work in ENG-99501.

Next steps: expand topology-aware heuristics (cross-node NVLink islands), add a continuous learning step to tune NCCL_THROTTLE_US automatically from warmup traces, and expose a per-customer opt-in experiment in the console.
review_comments: Arjun: Can you add a microbench that isolates the compaction cost vs collective savings? Requesting numbers for worst-case small-entry churn.
Maya: Added tp_slab_compaction_bench.py and included worst-case churn run in perf artifacts (see perf log). Compaction cost amortizes within 3-4 turns for our conversation workload.
Liam: Throttle looks plausible; default seems high for some PCIe setups. Can you make topology detection more conservative and add metric for throttle actions?
Maya: Adjusted probe to require two consecutive saturation samples before enabling throttle on PCIe topologies; added nccl_throttle_actions metric and logging.
Sofia: Please document feature flags and add guidance for tuning in the dedicated/private deploy docs. Also request a short rollback playbook.
Maya: Docs added at docs/runtime/tp/slab_compaction.md and included a rollback section. Added Linear tasks for follow-up tuning.
notes_summary: Merged PR introduces slab-based KV compaction and an adaptive NCCL throttler; measurable p99 improvements in NVLink rings and modest throughput wins. Feature gated and rolled out conservatively.
qa_notes: Perf artifacts uploaded to perf-bucket/redwood/pr-114512. QA: repro snippets, a quick injection test for throttle, and unit test checklist included.
changelog_entry: runtime: add KV slab compaction and NVLink-aware NCCL throttle to reduce small-collective overhead in tensor-parallel serving (opt-in behind flags)
